column1: # The 17 pr-review rounds that started per-criterion blind agents and ended between pr-review 0.39.0's push
# (2026-11-24 20:35 +03:00) and 2026-11-26, sm80-r2 when its PR closed (#80's round record :75-76). One more, started
# 2026-11-26 on a private-ticket PR, was still running and is left out. pr57-r1's and sm68's reviews took a ticket's
# "Expected" section as its criteria; neither ticket (O3-6248, O3-6261) has a section named acceptance criteria.
# launch / last_write: the earliest log/BRIEF.md and latest log/out.jsonl mtime among the round's Step 2 agents
#   (~/.claude/blind-runs/<date>-<agent>/), local time +03:00, to the second (scripts/round_times.py).
# owed: each agent pr-review 0.41.0's sentence (SKILL.md:38) makes owed, from criteria-rounds-owed-output.txt and
#   each LOADHIT report read in full: K killed at its deadline, N no report, R its report names the machine's load
#   and says a run it planned did not run or finish because the load slowed it, directly or by using up its time
#   budget or limit. "-" none. The reports of the agents not marked owed were scanned with a wider net
#   (scripts/unowed_scan.py, unowed-scan-output.txt) and each sentence it found read: that added sm79-r1-ac1 ("the
#   machine was too loaded for any of my Maven runs to finish"), which the pattern misses. Read as not owed:
#   sm78-r1-whole, whose report names the load as slowing a test class and a build its time limit stopped and that it
#   then ran again, and gives no reason for what it did not run; and pr69-ac1-fresh, whose "too slow to finish in the
#   time" does not name the load (the gap REJECTED.md :7953-7956 names for #69's agents).
# defect_by: the agents whose own report first carried a defect in the PR's change that the review reproduced and
#   that was missing from the findings this round's review recorded before it read the reports. An earlier round's
#   set-aside item that this round's agents re-raise counts unless this round's review recorded it first. One the
#   review then set aside as unlikely, unreachable or low in impact still counts (REJECTED.md :7761, "A reproduced
#   defect can still be set aside"). Not counted: an item the review had recorded first ("independently",
#   "re-found", "= my"), one it found pre-existing or outside the PR's change, one the ticket requires, a nit, or one
#   it did not reproduce. One also on the base counts when the PR rewrote the code that carries it (pr85-r1). "-" none.
# record: lines of ~/.claude/pr-review-rounds/<owner>__<repo>__<n>.md the two columns rest on.
